payload.reason: The evidence specifies the pretrained word embeddings used in the experiments, including GloVe and Edinburgh embeddings, along with their performance in different emotion categories.

claims.text: The pretrained word embeddings used include GloVe and Edinburgh embeddings.
Emoji embeddings outperform plain GloVe and Edinburgh embeddings in certain contexts.
Edinburgh embeddings outperform GloVe embeddings in Joy and Sadness categories but not in Anger and Fear categories.
